subtopics.label: Single-Cell RNA-Seq Methods, Tools, and Computational Frameworks
subtopics.description: Development and benchmarking of computational methods, statistical models, and experimental protocols for single-cell RNA sequencing, including differential expression analysis, demultiplexing, clustering, and data integration across cell types and conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Computational methods, statistical models, and experimental protocols for single-cell RNA sequencing, clustering, and data integration.

subtopics.label: Spatial Transcriptomics and Multiplexed Tissue Imaging
subtopics.description: Methods and applications of spatially resolved transcriptomics, multiplexed immunofluorescence, CODEX, and mass spectrometry imaging to map tissue architecture, cell-type distributions, and microenvironmental interactions at single-cell or near-single-cell resolution.
subtopics.short_description: Spatially resolved transcriptomics and multiplexed imaging to map cell-type distributions and microenvironmental interactions at single-cell resolution.

subtopics.label: Long-Read Sequencing and Single-Cell Isoform Resolution
subtopics.description: Application of long-read sequencing technologies (PacBio, Oxford Nanopore) and single-cell long-read methods to resolve full-length RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, and polyadenylation patterns across cell types, tissues, and disease states.
subtopics.short_description: Full-length RNA isoform and alternative splicing characterization across cell types using PacBio and Oxford Nanopore technologies.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Multi-Omics: Epigenome, Chromatin Accessibility, and Transcriptome Integration
subtopics.description: Joint profiling of chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, DNA methylation, and transcriptome in single cells to characterize epigenetic regulation of cell identity, differentiation, and disease-associated cell states.
subtopics.short_description: Joint profiling of chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, DNA methylation, and transcriptome to map epigenetic cell identity.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Immune Cell Heterogeneity in Cancer
subtopics.description: Single-cell and spatial characterization of immune cell composition, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, and stromal interactions within the tumor microenvironment across cancer types, linking cellular heterogeneity to clinical outcomes and immunotherapy response.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, and stromal interactions across cancer types linked to immunotherapy response.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Transcriptomics of Brain Cell Types and Neurological Disease
subtopics.description: Single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of neurons, glia, and microglia to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, splicing, and disease-associated states in neurodegeneration, psychiatric disorders, and brain injury.
subtopics.display_name: Brain Cell Types & Neurological Disease States
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of neurons, glia, and microglia in neurodegeneration, psychiatric disorders, and brain injury.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Analysis of Hematopoiesis, Clonal Evolution, and Blood Disorders
subtopics.description: Single-cell genomic and transcriptomic approaches to characterize hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, somatic mutations, and lineage dynamics in normal hematopoiesis and hematologic malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Stem and progenitor cell differentiation, clonal hematopoiesis, and lineage dynamics in normal and malignant blood disorders.

subtopics.label: Organoids, Stem Cell Differentiation, and Cell Fate Specification
subtopics.description: Use of organoids, pluripotent stem cell-derived models, and single-cell profiling to study cell fate decisions, lineage specification, and tissue development, including applications to disease modeling in cardiac, pancreatic, neural, and other organ systems.
subtopics.short_description: Organoid and pluripotent stem cell models for studying cell fate decisions, lineage specification, and multi-organ disease modeling.

subtopics.label: Lineage Tracing, Cell Plasticity, and Tumor Evolution
subtopics.description: Single-cell approaches to track clonal lineages, measure phenotypic plasticity, and reconstruct evolutionary trajectories in cancer and normal tissue, using barcoding, mitochondrial DNA mutations, and computational methods to infer cell state transitions.
subtopics.short_description: Clonal lineage tracking, phenotypic plasticity, and evolutionary trajectory reconstruction in cancer and normal tissue.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Characterization of Airway and Lung Epithelial Biology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and spatial profiling of airway and lung epithelial cell types to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, disease-associated dysregulation, and responses to infection or injury in conditions such as COPD, IPF, and COVID-19.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptomic and spatial profiling of lung epithelial cell types in COPD, IPF, COVID-19, and infection-related injury.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics Profiling of Spaceflight-Associated Physiological Changes
subtopics.description: Comprehensive single-cell, transcriptomic, proteomic, and epigenomic profiling of astronaut biospecimens to characterize molecular and cellular responses to spaceflight, including immune dysregulation, hematopoietic changes, and tissue-specific adaptations.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular responses to spaceflight in astronaut biospecimens, including immune dysregulation and hematopoietic changes.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell Atlas of Pancreatic Islets and Diabetes Pathophysiology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and multi-omic profiling of pancreatic islet cell types, including beta cell heterogeneity and dysfunction, to elucidate mechanisms of type 1 and type 2 diabetes and identify therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic profiling of islet cell types and beta cell dysfunction to elucidate mechanisms of type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

subtopics.label: Proteomic Profiling and Cell Surface Characterization
subtopics.description: Mass spectrometry-based and proximity proteomics approaches to characterize cell-type-specific protein expression, surface proteomes, extracellular vesicles, and protein-protein interactions in cancer, disease, and normal tissue contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry and proximity proteomics to map cell-type-specific protein expression, surface proteomes, and extracellular vesicles.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells and Gut Immune Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Single-cell and functional characterization of innate lymphoid cell (ILC) subsets, their transcriptional regulation, and their roles in intestinal immune homeostasis, tolerance, and inflammatory responses.
subtopics.display_name: Innate Lymphoid Cells & Gut Immune Homeostasis
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptional regulation and functional roles of ILC subsets in intestinal immune homeostasis, tolerance, and inflammation.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Heterogeneity and Vascular Biology
subtopics.description: Single-cell transcriptomic and functional characterization of endothelial cell subtypes, their specification during organogenesis and regeneration, and their roles in angiogenesis, tissue homeostasis, and disease contexts including cancer and organ development.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial cell subtype specification, angiogenesis, and tissue homeostasis across organogenesis, cancer, and organ development.

subtopics.label: B Cell Lymphoma Genomics, Epigenetics, and Transformation
subtopics.description: Research into the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms driving B cell lymphoma development, including cohesin complex dosage, chromatin regulators (CREBBP, KMT2D, EZH2), and oncogenic mutations (BTG1, TBL1XR1) that promote malignant transformation and immune evasion.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms driving B cell lymphoma transformation, including chromatin regulators and oncogenic mutations.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Differentiation Commitment
subtopics.description: Studies examining how cell cycle progression, G1 phase checkpoints, and molecular competition regulate the timing of terminal differentiation and cell fate commitment, including roles of CDK4/6, lipid checkpoints, and circadian rhythms.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms by which cell cycle checkpoints, CDK4/6, and circadian rhythms govern terminal differentiation and fate commitment timing.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation, Metabolism, and Proteomics
subtopics.description: Research characterizing adipocyte differentiation programs and metabolic regulation using proteomic and transcriptomic approaches, including SILAC-based profiling of 3T3-L1 cells, metformin effects, HIF1α-PPARγ networks, and circadian control of preadipocyte commitment.
subtopics.short_description: Proteomic and transcriptomic characterization of adipocyte differentiation programs, metabolic networks, and circadian control.

subtopics.label: Transcriptomic Profiling of Kidney Transplant Rejection and Allografts
subtopics.description: Single-cell and bulk RNA-sequencing studies of kidney allografts to characterize immune cell infiltration, T cell and NK cell gene signatures, fibroblast origins, and molecular markers associated with acute and chronic rejection.
subtopics.short_description: RNA-sequencing of kidney allografts to characterize immune infiltration and molecular markers of acute and chronic rejection.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Immune Response, Epigenetics, and Vascular Pathology
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the immunological and epigenetic consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including DNA methylation signatures in severe disease, epigenetic memory in hematopoietic progenitors, fungal microbiota-driven neutrophil activation, and vascular necroptosis in ARDS.
subtopics.short_description: Immunological and epigenetic effects of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including methylation signatures, hematopoietic memory, and vascular pathology.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Regeneration, Cardiomyocyte Biology, and Heart Injury Response
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac regeneration mechanisms including epicardial progenitor activation in zebrafish, cross-species inflammatory responses to heart injury, cardiomyocyte isolation and division quantification, and SARS-CoV-2-induced ferroptosis in pacemaker cells.
subtopics.short_description: Epicardial progenitor activation, cross-species injury responses, and cardiomyocyte dynamics in heart regeneration and disease.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy: T Cell Therapies, Immune Combinations, and Tumor Immune Evasion
subtopics.description: Studies on enhancing anti-tumor immunity through combination immunotherapy strategies, including CAR-T cell therapies, GITR engagement, neutrophil-T cell cooperation, radiation plus checkpoint blockade, and mechanisms of tumor immune escape via chromosomal instability and endothelial necroptosis.
subtopics.short_description: CAR-T therapies, checkpoint combinations, and mechanisms of tumor immune escape via chromosomal instability and endothelial necroptosis.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Follicle Biology and Reproductive Cell Characterization
subtopics.description: Single-cell and molecular studies characterizing ovarian follicle cell populations, including theca cell subtypes, antral follicle isolation protocols, xenograft versus native follicle molecular signatures, and AMH-driven premature luteinization.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization of ovarian follicle cell populations, theca subtypes, and AMH-driven premature luteinization.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer Stem Cells, Microenvironment, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on colorectal cancer initiation and progression focusing on epithelial aPKC deficiency, hyaluronan-driven microenvironment remodeling, MTA2-SATB2 chromatin complexes maintaining colonic identity, and intestinal stem cell niche support.
subtopics.display_name: Colorectal Cancer Stem Cells & Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.short_description: Colorectal cancer initiation and progression via epithelial deficiency, hyaluronan remodeling, and chromatin complex dysregulation.

subtopics.label: Lupus and Autoimmune Innate Immune Dysregulation
subtopics.description: Studies examining innate immune mechanisms in lupus, including IFN-driven IL-1β secretion in monocytes, Langerhans cell ADAM17 regulation in photosensitivity, and lymphatic fluid as an immunosurveillance conduit for tissue-specific inflammatory signals.
subtopics.short_description: Innate immune mechanisms in lupus, including IFN-driven monocyte activation, Langerhans cell regulation, and lymphatic immunosurveillance.

subtopics.label: Circulating Tumor Cells and Liquid Biopsy in Cancer
subtopics.description: Methods and analyses for isolating and characterizing circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in cancer patients, including HER2-low CTC isolation, CTC cluster genomics, and machine learning integration for treatment response prediction.
subtopics.short_description: Isolation and genomic characterization of CTCs and ctDNA for treatment response prediction and cancer monitoring.

subtopics.label: Liver Cell Biology: Zonation, Fibrosis, and Transcriptional Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on hepatic cell biology including aging-associated disruption of hepatocyte zonation, HNF4α regulation in cirrhosis and liver failure, hedgehog-driven peribiliary fibrogenic mesenchymal cells, and AAV vector tropism in liver cells.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatocyte zonation, HNF4α regulation in cirrhosis, hedgehog-driven fibrogenic cells, and AAV tropism in liver biology.

subtopics.label: Chromosomal Instability, Epigenetic Reprogramming, and Cancer Progression
subtopics.description: Studies on how chromosomal instability and epigenetic dysregulation drive cancer progression and metastasis, including PRC1 loss in uveal melanoma, non-cell-autonomous CIN-driven metastasis, PKCλ/ι inhibition activating interferon responses, and machine learning prediction of chromatin conformation in cancer.
subtopics.short_description: How chromosomal instability and epigenetic dysregulation drive cancer metastasis, immune evasion, and chromatin conformation changes.

subtopics.label: Stem Cell Reprogramming, Pluripotency, and Epigenetic Bookmarking
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms of cellular reprogramming to pluripotency, including gene regulatory networks in iPSC generation, H3K27ac bookmarking post-mitosis, incomplete DNA replication in low-potency PSCs, and OTX2-driven enhancer remodeling in endoderm specification.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of iPSC reprogramming, H3K27ac bookmarking, DNA replication fidelity, and enhancer remodeling in endoderm.

subtopics.label: Skeletal Stem Cells, Bone Biology, and Metastasis
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing skeletal stem cell lineages in bone development and cancer metastasis, including vertebral skeletal stem cells driving breast cancer metastasis, craniosynostosis multi-stem cell basis, and single-cell preparation methods for skeletal cells.
subtopics.display_name: Skeletal Stem Cells, Bone Biology & Metastasis
subtopics.short_description: Skeletal stem cell lineages in bone development, breast cancer metastasis, craniosynostosis, and single-cell preparation methods.
